messages:
Joanne: Canary deploy finished for release v2.14.0 — started at 2026-03-17T12:12:03Z, canary on us-west-2 small pool.
Mike: Kicking off post-deploy smoke suite now (scripts/smoke/quick_checks.sh). I’ll stream results here.
Mike: running: `./smoke/quick_checks.sh --target canary`
deploy-bot: Canary rollout step recorded: 3/3 instances updated. No immediate errors.
Mike: check-1: app health OK, /health => 200
Mike: check-2: model-inference endpoint responding, avg latency 78ms (10 reqs)
Lisa: watching latency dashboards — p50 72ms, p95 210ms (spike at 12:18) — looks transient
Arjun: verifying model fallback routes and KV cache warming.
Arjun: curl -sS "https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate?model=redwood-7b" -H "Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**" | jq '.status' => "ok"
Joanne: Any 5xxs in the last 15m?
sre-bot: Alert summary (15m): 5xx_count=0, rate_limit_errors=0, cpu_util_us-west-2=62%
Mike: tokenization errors: 2/500 requests returned tokenizer_warn in logs — tagging Arjun.
Arjun: I see the two warnings — they were long-prefix edge cases; not a crash. Will push a small tokenizer tolerance patch to canary in ~10m.
Joanne: Good. Can we confirm fallback behavior if a GPU node OOMs?
Arjun: yes — smart routing will fall back to quantized-variant (redwood-7b-8bit) and preserve KV cache where possible. I ran a simulated OOM failover: fallback route returned 200 and latency increased to ~310ms.
Lisa: Observed model_quality regression checks (eval-run id=eval/17680) -> pass rate 98.6% (threshold 97%).
Mike: smoke script summary: 12 checks passed, 1 warning (tokenizer_warn), 0 failures.
Joanne: OK timeline: if no further issues by 12:25 UTC, we promote to prod. Mike/Arjun — are you green for prod rollout?
Mike: green from infra side. Will keep the smoke watcher on during prod ramp.
Arjun: green. Will monitor fallback and KV cache warming during ramp.
Lisa: I’ll keep an eye on latency and tail errors in the dashboard and drop any anomalies here.
Joanne: Roger. Rollback plan reminder: manual rollback via deploy console (rollback -> previous_release) or `deploy-cli rollback v2.13.9` if we see functional regressions.
Mike: I’ll ensure on-call can run the rollback; leaving a precautional runbook link: https://goto.redwood/runbooks/deploy-rollback
Joanne: Rolling to prod now (starting canary->prod lift at 12:25 UTC). Stand by for incremental metrics. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod initiated. Canary percentage -> 30%.
Mike: prod canary 30%: initial traffic looks healthy. p50 80ms, p95 240ms.
Lisa: prod eval runner in progress, first 500 requests sampled. quality pass (99.0%) so far.
Arjun: deploying tokenizer tolerance patch to canary as planned (hotfix) and will coordinate cache warm.
Mike: small config note — autoscale warmup set to 45s for this fleet; watch node spin-up latency.
Joanne: If anything degrades beyond thresholds (p95 > 400ms or error_rate > 0.5%), we rollback.
sre-bot: Threshold monitor armed: p95_threshold=400ms, error_rate_threshold=0.5%, notification_channel=#eng-oncall.
Mike: prod ramp to 60% at 12:31 UTC — metrics steady.
Lisa: p50 85ms, p95 230ms, error_rate 0.07% (all under thresholds).
Arjun: fallback exercised once during ramp for a short window — routed to quantized variant, no user-visible errors.
Joanne: Final check: Pete from product wanted a quick smoke of chat tool — Mike can you run /chat quick smoke?
Mike: ran chat smoke, conversation flow OK, tool-calls working.
Joanne: Good work team. Keeping this thread open for any post-ramp anomalies. I’ll create a short post-deploy note for release notes after we stabilize. :white_check_mark:
Mike: leaving a small log excerpt of the tokenizer warning for record:
```
[2026-03-17T12:18:42Z] WARN tokenizer: long-prefix-length(10240) -> tokenization tolerant fallback used for req id=abcd1234
```
Arjun: noted, will add a tiny unit test to cover the long-prefix case in the next patch.
Lisa: setting a 30m post-deploy watch reminder.
Joanne: thread closed when watch expires. Thanks everyone.
